# Plugins reference

The system plugins compiled into Nocterm, and the panels and widgets they and the shell offer to the window. A contribution's placement is a hint: the Default layout places it by zone and order, and a saved layout may place it elsewhere.

## Panel groups

Panels in one group exclude each other. The primary group holds the sidebar.

| Group | Title | Primary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `navigation` | Sidebar | yes |
| `assistant` | Assistant | no |

## Shell

Contributions of the window shell and its core features. They are not plugins and cannot be switched off.

| Id | Kind | Title | Zone | Order | Group | Auto | Pinned |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `connections.servers` | panel | Connections | left | 10 | `navigation` | show | no |
| `files.explorer` | panel | Explorer | left | 20 | `navigation` | show | no |
| `workspace.notifications` | widget | Notifications | right | 10 | none | show | yes |
| `files.transfers` | widget | Transfers | right | 20 | none | show | no |
| `workspace.local-terminal` | widget | Local Terminal | right | 30 | none | show | no |
